name: GitHub Actions
description: Automate build, test, image publication, and GitOps delivery with GitHub Actions workflows.
current_level_fit: Foundational to intermediate DevOps experience.
practical_next_action: Build a workflow that tests an application and publishes an immutable image digest.
common_pitfalls: Allowing pipelines to drift without shared standards

name: Azure DevOps
description: Plan work, manage repos, and run pipelines with Azure DevOps services.
current_level_fit: Best for learners who need pipeline and delivery workflow practice.
practical_next_action: Create a pipeline that builds a sample app and publishes an artifact.
common_pitfalls: Mixing governance and delivery concerns too early

name: GitLab CI
description: Define repeatable pipelines with GitLab CI stages, jobs, and runners.
current_level_fit: Good for practitioners who want hands-on pipeline orchestration.
practical_next_action: Add a GitLab CI pipeline that runs tests and builds a container image.
common_pitfalls: Embedding too much logic in a single job

name: Kubernetes
description: Deploy and operate containerized workloads on a Kubernetes cluster.
current_level_fit: Intermediate to advanced platform and DevOps growth.
practical_next_action: Deploy one sample app to a local cluster and inspect pods, services, and logs.

name: Argo CD
description: Use GitOps to continuously reconcile Kubernetes state from version control.
current_level_fit: Best once Kubernetes basics are already familiar.
practical_next_action: Create an Argo CD application that syncs a sample Helm chart.
common_pitfalls: Mixing deployment logic with application code

name: Helm
description: Package Kubernetes manifests into reusable charts with values and templates.
current_level_fit: Useful for engineers already comfortable with Kubernetes basics.
practical_next_action: Refactor static Kubernetes manifests into a reusable Helm chart.

name: .NET
description: Support .NET build, packaging, and deployment workflows in a DevOps pipeline.
current_level_fit: Helpful for Windows and application-delivery focused careers.
practical_next_action: Build and test a small .NET application in the pipeline of your choice.
common_pitfalls: Coupling build steps to a single machine

name: MSI
description: Create Windows installer packages and maintain repeatable installation flows.
current_level_fit: Useful for application packaging and desktop deployment paths.
practical_next_action: Package one internal utility as an MSI and test a silent install.
common_pitfalls: Not validating install and uninstall behavior

name: Advanced Installer
description: Use Advanced Installer to build and maintain Windows installation packages.
current_level_fit: Good for Windows packaging and release engineering roles.
practical_next_action: Create a package that includes install, repair, and uninstall flows.

name: Windows Administration
description: Manage Windows systems, services, and operational tasks that support DevOps workflows.
current_level_fit: Good for infrastructure and endpoint operations experience.
practical_next_action: Automate one administrative task and document the repeatable steps.

name: OpenShift
description: Operate containerized workloads on Red Hat OpenShift with a Kubernetes-compatible workflow.
current_level_fit: Useful for platform teams already familiar with Kubernetes patterns.
practical_next_action: Deploy a sample workload and compare OpenShift-specific operational tasks to Kubernetes.
common_pitfalls: Treating OpenShift as identical to vanilla Kubernetes

name: Linux
description: Build command-line confidence, package management skills, and service troubleshooting habits on Linux.
current_level_fit: Foundational for most DevOps and platform engineering paths.
practical_next_action: Practice basic shell, package, and service-management tasks on one Linux environment.
common_pitfalls: Treating Linux admin as separate from automation

name: Docker
description: Package and run applications in containers for consistent local and CI execution.
current_level_fit: Foundational for container-based delivery and platform work.
practical_next_action: Containerize one existing application and run it locally and in CI.
common_pitfalls: Not separating build and runtime concerns

name: Docker Compose
description: Run a multi-container local environment for development and validation.
current_level_fit: Useful for local development and integration test setups.
practical_next_action: Describe a two-service local stack in Compose and bring it up repeatedly.
common_pitfalls: Treating Compose as a production deployment tool

name: Certificates
description: Manage certificates and trust chains for secure service communication.
current_level_fit: Important for platform, infrastructure, and security-oriented roles.
practical_next_action: Inventory one certificate chain and document renewal and rotation steps.
common_pitfalls: Storing private keys in plain text

name: HashiCorp Vault
description: Store and manage secrets centrally with a repeatable secrets workflow.
current_level_fit: Useful for operators who need secure secret delivery patterns.
practical_next_action: Use Vault to issue a short-lived secret for one sample workflow.
common_pitfalls: Embedding secret values in code or pipelines

name: Ansible
description: Automate configuration and repeatable operational tasks with playbooks and roles.
current_level_fit: Great for infrastructure automation and repeatable operations work.
practical_next_action: Write one playbook that configures a VM or service from scratch.
common_pitfalls: Mixing ad hoc tasks with reusable roles

name: Terraform
description: Provision infrastructure with versioned, declarative, repeatable configuration.
current_level_fit: Core for platform engineering and cloud infrastructure paths.
practical_next_action: Provision one sample environment from code and review the resulting state.
common_pitfalls: Keeping modules too large to reuse

name: VMware
description: Operate virtualization and host resources that support internal platforms and labs.
current_level_fit: Useful for infrastructure and virtualized environment operations.
practical_next_action: Create or inspect one virtual machine lifecycle workflow and document it.
common_pitfalls: Treating virtualization as a black box

name: AWS
description: Use AWS services to deliver cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities.
current_level_fit: Important for cloud-focused DevOps and platform roles.
practical_next_action: Deploy a sample workload to one AWS service and document the tradeoffs.

name: MLOps
description: Support machine-learning delivery with repeatable data, model, and platform workflows.
current_level_fit: Best once basic DevOps delivery and platform skills are already established.
practical_next_action: Containerize one model-serving workflow and define its delivery path.
common_pitfalls: Treating model delivery like static application delivery

name: SecOps
description: Embed security operations and platform controls into delivery workflows.
current_level_fit: Most useful for mature platform and release engineering paths.
practical_next_action: Add one security check or secret-handling control to an existing workflow.
common_pitfalls: Treating security as a final gate only
Skipping secrets, certificates, and policy basics
